parameter_rationale.resample_points: The 16-position representation is the discovery-selected resolution of the original geometric method and is held identical across distances, so only the distance function changes.
parameter_rationale.dtw: Unconstrained dynamic time warping is used on the fixed 16-by-16 representation. Accumulated cost is divided by the selected alignment-path length to avoid favouring shorter paths.
parameter_rationale.discrete_frechet: The standard discrete Frechet recurrence is used on the same absolute-coordinate prefixes and introduces no additional parameter.
parameter_rationale.translation: Translation is not removed, matching the original geometric retrieval protocol.
parameter_rationale.bootstrap: The replicate count matches the primary experiment; the seed is fixed before the robustness outputs are inspected.
